جِلٌّ : see جَلِيلٌ, in six places ＝
-A2- Also The stalks of seed-produce [or corn] when it has been reaped; (S, O, Mgh, K;) as also ↓ جُلٌّ and ↓ جَلٌّ : (K:) when it has been removed to the place where the grain is trodden out, and has been trodden, and cut by means of the مِدْوَس, it is called تِبْنٌ. (AHn, Mgh.) And, by amplification, applied to The stalks remaining upon the field after the reaping. (Mgh in the present art. and in art. حصد.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
